preconditions.description: The dimensions of the matrix w must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= w[i][j] <= 10**9 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All elements of the matrix w must be non-negative integers within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if not valid_matrix(w, n, m) else True
postconditions.description: If the matrix w cannot be obtained, output 'NO'.
If the matrix w can be obtained, output 'YES' followed by k, a, and b.

postconditions.expression: 1 <= k <= 10**18 and all(0 <= a[i] <= 10**18 for i in range(n)) and all(0 <= b[j] <= 10**18 for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: The values of k, a, and b must be within the specified bounds.
